description: Your team spots something in the report, and you hear about it as a screenshot pasted into PowerPoint or through a complicated workaround. The number lives in Power BI. The explanation lives in somebody's inbox. By the next review, nobody remembers why the variance happened. Zebra BI Tables+ brings Power BI commenting to the people who read your reports. It is a new visual, built on the capabilities of Zebra BI Tables, the leading Power BI matrix visual. The difference is: analysts, controllers, and executives add and manage comments directly on the data, in view mode, with no Power BI edit access. • Power BI commenting in view mode. Viewers add context on the exact row, no edit rights required. • Comments stay in your Microsoft 365. Stored in a SharePoint Excel file you own. Zebra BI stores and processes nothing. • Governance stays separate. Power BI permissions decide who sees the report, SharePoint permissions decide who comments. • Built-in P&L logic. Invert, result, and skip rows with a single click. • Automatic variance calculations. Absolute and relative, no manual DAX. • Four table types in one matrix visual. Comparison, hierarchical, cross-tab, and calculation tables. • Responsive, IBCS-compliant layouts. Consistent reporting on web and mobile. Popular Use Cases • Month-end variance commentary.
